a.reachDefinition: 4-neighbour walkable components with no tile on the render boundary or beside omitted fixed ground; cropped paths leaving the view are treated as reachable. Cyan walkability-tree paths link boundary samples and markers; orange = isolated.
a.note: Land shares and axial runs sample chunk centres. Rectangles include both endpoints. Fixed authored chunks are grey hatching and excluded from tile/camp/place metrics. Entities white; sites magenta; lamp stones yellow; rumours orange; places red.

note: Panels: A, B, changed. Tile changes compare ground ID, solidity, decor, entities, sites and places; atlas compares land and river crossing. Overlays do not affect the change mask.
